info.title: 映创 · Iteration 7 Creative Studio API
info.description: Local creative studio. Default secure mode requires authenticated organization membership, CSRF and a non-empty Origin for writes. Secure-mode CORS permits only FRONTEND_ORIGIN and explicitly configured AUTH_ALLOWED_ORIGINS; null, wildcard and other origins are denied. Deployment administrators are pinned by STUDIO_ADMIN_USER_IDS, never an unverified email claim. Explicit AUTH_MODE=demo is local-only and provides no tenant security. Real model runtime requires current authorization, configured capabilities; automatic moderation is temporarily disabled by default and may be required by deployment policy; local costs and quotas do not gate execution. Local protocol tests are not live quality verification.

handoff_url.description: Explicit user-click App scheme; encrypted expiring media capability. Never persist in browser/logs or launch automatically.

LibraryCard.description: Exactly one typed card. Style/voice cards describe creative intent; they are not provider controls, voice identities or authorization. Per-version metadata uses a bounded request working set, not a project quota.

LibraryReferenceInput.description: Exactly one reference source: project image, or an existing reference from a version of this same library asset. Stored references are independent of source-project lifetime. Library references are accepted only when creating a new version.

library_sources.description: Server-written ancestry, not a grant. Reused for each future generation; copying or deriving does not remove ancestor revocations.

provenance_version.description: Server-frozen complete inherited scope for this reference. Legacy references dynamically follow their trusted source project/media record. Missing old records never establish a new authorization root.

LibraryWrite.description: Authored card versions. No fixed reference-count or prohibited-change-count quota. Voice cards currently accept textual performance intent only and must have references:[]; audio authorization and native dispatch are separate capabilities. Images are validated and prepared one at a time before metadata commit; partial preparations are not a successful version.

uploaded_asset_id.description: Immutable asset created by this upload request, including idempotent replay after later uploads.

episode_timelines.description: Independent episode timelines keyed by episode number 2..999. timeline remains episode 1. At most 120 saved episodes.

library_reference_limit.description: Actual single/multiple reference adapter capacity. Not a project asset quota.

director_controls.description: Actual selected adapter support. Authored text intentions are prompt_only, never exact native controls. An unresolved adapter reports unsupported.

UploadSession.description: Owner-only temporary transfer. Current organization membership is required on every request. Confirmed offset is durable; chunk size is a transport buffer, not an object/project quota. Whole-file SHA and native media validation precede asset acceptance. Completed/cancelled sessions retain their receipts; staged bytes are removed. Incomplete sessions expire after seven days.

mode.description: 交换目标编号，或插入目标位置并顺移区间内编号；不改变剧集或项目身份，也不修改旧导出编号。

shot_assignments.description: 未知归属镜头必须显式选0留原件，或本次来源集号；不会按邻近场次猜测。

EpisodeMigrationPlan.description: 只读预览；源记录不改动，digest绑定完整选择和来源快照。实际字节摘要由复制检查点封存并在发布前再次核对。issues非空不能创建任务。省略旧分镜时解除目标剪辑的旧镜头标签，原分镜留在源项目。

EpisodeMigrationSummary.description: 分页列表仅返回进度，不返回全部剧本、素材正文或检查点摘要。completed才表示目标可从目录访问；保存计划和copies完成不是发布成功。

EpisodeMigrationJob.description: 只读任务与原始计划；同键重放返回当前任务，不覆盖已完成项目的后续编辑。停止只移除尚未发布的目标，保留任务对账记录及安全的不可变Blob孤儿；不删除源记录或已发布集。

EpisodeMigrationContinue.description: 一个可恢复工作单元。旧expected_version只返回当前进度，不再多执行一个步骤；响应丢失后先查询原任务。

StoryWrite.description: Append an authored formal version. Never executes a model. Bible character voice_intent is descriptive prose and grants no voice or cloning authorization. Subjective facts require believer_id; other perspectives must omit it. Evidence must match the pinned stable scene and actual historical script digest. Creation expected_version=0; updates use the current number.

StoryContextPreview.description: Read-only authored context preview. Source versions and directory/script digests are pinned. Problems block use; never imply AI evaluation, token fit, generation, or voice permission. UTF-8 bytes are measured, not model tokens. The later executor must revalidate all pins.

StoryContextSelection.description: Deterministic case-insensitive substring OR retrieval; empty query selects by narrative scope. Required material cannot be excluded. No financial allowance or native token-fit assertion.

StoryRetrieval.description: Pinned retrieval result. Complete source summaries; selected bodies bounded by a per-request 2 MiB transport working set. Required overflow is a blocking problem; omitted optional bodies have explicit reasons.

StoryContextSnapshot.description: Immutable authored input and original receipt; no model execution or adoption. Viewing does not mean current sources still match. A later execution must revalidate every pin. Script is null before a first saved script.

StoryContextFreshness.description: Read-only comparison of pinned versions with current sources at the time of the check. Does not authorize dispatch; a later executor must recheck its own pins.

StoryCheck.description: Durable, gateway-only text continuity check. Poll GET; no automatic generation retries. unknown means an interrupted upstream outcome cannot be established. A result is advisory, not a formal story mutation. No budget/price fields are required.

StoryDecisionInput.description: Explicit human decision. adopt validates current source review, acknowledgement of changed inputs, and target CAS. reject/intentional require a reason and do not mutate formal material. Preserve original key/body on uncertainty.

StoryFindingReview.description: One pinned finding with its original evidence, current formal target and current comparison digest. Loading and comparing do not call a model. Only an explicit decision can append a formal version.

StorySuggestionWrite.description: Append an authored formal version. Never executes a model. Bible character voice_intent is descriptive prose and grants no voice or cloning authorization. Subjective facts require believer_id; other perspectives must omit it. Evidence must match the pinned stable scene and actual historical script digest. Creation expected_version=0; updates use the current number.

StoryEvidenceScriptSummary.description: Metadata only. Legacy scripts without stable scene identities are visible but cannot be used as scene evidence. No restore or upgrade is performed.

StoryEvidenceScript.description: One explicitly selected immutable stable script. The server computes the digest. Reading does not restore, generate, or change the current script. Formal saves verify each quote against this exact version and scene again.

LibraryUseAuthorization.description: Current creator-attested use declaration, independent of immutable content versions. Not verified legal rights or a capability. Regrant replaces scope and increments revision; pending jobs require the same revision. Revocation does not rewrite old receipts or content.

authorization.description: Current creator-attested use declaration, independent of immutable content versions. Not verified legal rights or a capability. Regrant replaces scope and increments revision; pending jobs require the same revision. Revocation does not rewrite old receipts or content.

LibraryAuthorizationInput.description: At most 256 KiB normalized metadata per operation (working-set boundary, not an asset/project quota). Version scope must be explicit existing versions of this asset. No automatic future-version authorization. Revoke omits all grant fields. Actor and timestamps are server-owned.

model.description: Exact public model alias, same grammar as the configured gateway model. Never a URL or credential.

NativeVoicePreset.description: Public model-specific native voice token. No credential, audio identity or cloning claim. The executing model ID/provider/model and token must exactly match.

LibraryInputChoice.description: An explicit mode on an immutable project library binding. reference selects exact copied images and includes visual card text. prompt_only carries no images. native_preset is one model-specific speech voice, never cloning or reading intent notes aloud.

LibraryInputPin.description: Server-fixed version, applied mode, exact authorization revisions and explicitly omitted intent fields. Authorization is rechecked before every new dispatch. Output lineage includes these roots, including native speech and text-only direction.

actor.description: Server-authenticated creator who made this decision; not accepted from the request.

reviewed_changes.description: Required true if project version has changed since this candidate was generated. expected_version still must equal the current project version.

script.description: Optional creator-edited candidate. Omit to adopt the original. Stable project identity schema must be retained.

review_context_snapshot_id.description: Required for a candidate using canonical story context. Must be a current snapshot with the same original retrieval selection. Current directory, canonical heads and project version are guarded during the local adoption commit. Changes require reviewed_changes=true. Original request replay bypasses new source checks and never reapplies.

StoryOutline.description: Canonical authored plan. Missing episode_id means season arc; a plan is not an event that has occurred. One stable record per season/episode scope; immutable versions, no project count quota.

omitted_neighbours.description: An adjacent shot was omitted because its episode differs or cannot be established. No future episode body is sent.

AnimaticSource.description: Immutable local rehearsal source. Bytes are pinned at admission and rechecked before each render/resume. No runtime grants, credentials, publishing permission or model requests are restored. Repeated shots and images are allowed; each clip has a distinct render identity. A temporary audio clip plays once from its start, is trimmed at the shot end and padded with silence when shorter.

shot_episodes.description: Resolved against the exact storyboard script revision; 0 means independent legacy shot to assign explicitly, -1 means unavailable historical scope. No full script/history bodies returned.
